title: Egypt Navigates Strategic Balancing Act Between Gulf Allies, Iran, and Gaza Mediation
detail: Analysis published by The National highlighted Egypt's increasingly complex diplomatic position: backing Gulf allies (UAE, Saudi Arabia) against Iranian threats while maintaining open back-channels to Tehran, and simultaneously serving as indispensable mediator between Israel and Hamas in stalled Gaza Phase-2 ceasefire talks. Egyptian FM Badr Abdelatty participated in the BRICS foreign ministers' meeting in New Delhi, meeting Brazilian FM Mauro Vieira on the sidelines to discuss tech, innovation, defense, and counterterrorism cooperation. A White House envoy continued to praise Egypt as an 'indispensable' partner in the Gaza process. Gaza Phase-2 talks remained stalled over Hamas's refusal to accept an Israeli disarmament framework and Israel's refusal to withdraw from the so-called 'yellow line' inside Gaza.

media.caption: Egypt navigates a strategic balancing act between Gulf allies, Iran, and its Gaza mediator role
